content: Yeesu hultiɗ
Wa nohi muy po mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse reehha, Mari Makdala na Salome na Mari yaay ɓi Saak rommba eeñɗoha ne ɓa reefa fiɗaafaŋ Yeesu.
Ŋ Kooh-wiisiina na ɓaaɓa teel, wa ɓitiɓ ceem reyee ruy-ruya, raak nohi haneeɗa pul.
Ɓa woyeeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa ne : « Moo ! Ya ɓa na hee ɓoo pilnginɗe atoh fa rangohu ruy-ruya ? »
Ɓa jaɗtukka, ɓa hotta ne atoh fa rangee wa pilnginuuɗ te wa nikee atoh yakoh na yakoh.
Ɓa aassa ŋ ruy-ruya, ɓa hotta fiir ɓekkiɗ sabidoor yaanow melciɗ, ɓoofiɗ ŋ ɓaka ñaahma, ɓa feyuusa jameet.
Waaye, ƴaara woosa ɓa ne : « Kanaat feyu, ɗu na marke Yeesu yiŋ Nasareet, yi daaƴse ŋ kurwaa. A hultiɗuuɗ, a nikisɗi ndii, ɗiski a ɗaaksee weɗɗi.
Ɗiski wa nik, kaɗaat ɗu woya taalubeeci, Piyeer na ɓinooɓi, ne a yaa adug ɗu Galile. Ɗu na hee ɗe hotohe ndaam findi a woyohee ɗu wa. »
Ɓa pulla ruy-ruya, ɓa saandoheeɗa. Ɓa nikee saakɗoheeɗa sagu tiit, neƴƴoheem tahha po ɓa wooɗi ali ɓo' in. [
Wa Yeesu hulit ŋ mbehi koc na ɓaaɓa, a ɗeɓ teeɓ haf ce Mari Makdala. A yi ɓitɓa a saɓsohee na jiini yasna-kanak.
Yeem kaɗta, a raakka ɓa meeɗ hun na Yeesu fuɗeeɗa kakaan kiŋ ɗe ; a naandsukka ɓa wa.
Waaye, wa a woo ɓa ne : « Yeesu hultiɗ, ŋ hotiɗ ɗe ! » Ɓa kosɗi ɗe.
Ƴutta, Yeesu teeɓkissa taalube kanak, ŋ ñaamaar ɗalohiɗ na wa koc, raak ɓa ŋ waas ŋ bilaf fa.
Ɓa hayya, ɓa naandsukkaa taalubeeca ɓinooɓa, waaye ɓa namɗaa kos.
Ŋ mirndaani, a teeɓukka Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na yinooci (11), raak ɓa ɓoofiɗ ñameeɗa. A ngassa ɓa ŋ ndengkiŋ ɓa keeñ na ini ɓa kosɗi ɓooɓi hot ɗe hultiɗuuɗ.
A hannda ɓa woo ne : « Kaɗaat ŋ adinaani jen, ɗu woo ɓooɓi feru jen Yegɗohiŋ Muci.
Yaa nu kos te a ɓoktu ɗah, a hey muce, waaye yaa nu kosɗi ɗah, a hey atte'se findi bakaaɗoh.
Te in ci ɓooɓi kosan ndo inhisohsan ceɗi cii : Ɓa hey aañe jiini ŋ tiikiŋ ngo, ɓa jombee ɓi peɗeem as,
ali ɓa amb iiñ wala ɓa an posani na ape sah, ali in rahsanɗi ɓa. Ɓa hey dege kosaayiɗ ci yaah, ɓa wir. »
Wa Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu ƴut ɓa woo in ceem, a rapɗuusa ŋ Eel ca, a ɓooffa ŋ ñaahmaŋ Kooh.
Taalubeeci woosa Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ ɗisik nu nik, Heɗ ɓoo ambɗohha ɓa ŋ pangkeem, in ci feyohiɗ ci a haɓɗee ɗisik nu ɓa kaɗ ɗah, ca teeɓohha ne woo kiŋ ɓa, wa keeh.]

footnotes.text: Aaya 9-20, e Maarko fiis ca haa. Ɓo' inahɗi andi a rawɗi ɗiindoh teerndiŋ ɗe, andi ini a fiis muuƴ muuƴ. Kon, aayaacii, ɓi ɓo' wiiriis fiis ca. Ca fiis maañiɗ, ca fiisu ŋ finho hayiŋ Yeesu, bala kiis 150 reyan ɗah, te in ci ca woo, ca hun na in ci Luk na Macce na Saaŋ fiis.
